C0007.title: Criminalization of Game Cheats: Legal Disputes over Simulated Manual Operation Scripts
C0007.summary: The cited legal and security materials discuss typed assessment of game cheats. Simulated-player-operation cheats mainly automate play through key simulators, fixed keystroke-sequence replay, or image-recognition-triggered inputs. The materials note that such tools usually do not directly modify game data or protocols, so criminal-law analysis needs to distinguish whether they have functions for intrusion, illegal control, or destruction of computer information systems.
